issues.en: Illegitimate birth (внѣбрачной). The word for 'daughter' is garbled ('досо'); sex inferred from 'родившаяся'. Year of birth written '1404'. Godparents illegible. Surname is the mother's patronymic-form Касперовичевнай (margin).
